plots.name: clock-demo
plots.title: A ticker you can stop
plots.lesson: Predict: what changes if the interval doubles? Try this ticker, watch its pulses, then change 1s to 2s and try again. Open Patchbay and select the ticker to follow the cord from time/every to presentation/tick. Lull stops the run; Wake admits another run. This specimen shows a repeating pulse, not the time of day.

plots.name: memory_lantern
plots.title: Turn keystrokes into text
plots.lesson: Try the plot, focus the running example, and type a short message. Open Patchbay and select Memory Lantern: follow keyboard events through key mapping and bounded editing to visible text. Which part turns an event into a character? Your body survives reload; this example does not promise to retain the message.

plots.name: hello-demo
plots.title: Uppercase a greeting
plots.lesson: Predict the uppercase result, then try it. Change the greeting and try again. The final period makes this a finite plot. Inspect the literal, uppercase gear, and display in Patchbay.

plots.name: text-lab
plots.title: Uppercase as you type
plots.lesson: Try it, focus the running example, and type a few letters. Keyboard events become text before text/upper changes its case. Compare this immediate transformation with the editable message in Memory Lantern.

plots.name: scale-demo
plots.title: Scale a number
plots.lesson: Predict 1.5 multiplied by 2.0. Try it, then change the factor to 3.0 and compare the displayed result. Inspect the typed scalar ports in Patchbay.

plots.name: logic-demo
plots.title: Invert a Boolean
plots.lesson: Predict the opposite of true, then try it. Change the literal to false. Follow the Boolean through the inversion gear and display in Patchbay.

plots.name: convert-pitch-demo
plots.title: Units: kilohertz to hertz
plots.lesson: Predict how many hertz are in 1kHz. Try it: the receipt stores the exact coordinate as coefficient 1 and exponent 3. Change 1kHz to 2kHz; the displayed check changes because the result is now 2000 Hz. Inspect the conversion and receipt in Patchbay.

plots.name: compare-distance-demo
plots.title: Units: compare distances
plots.lesson: Predict whether 1000mm and 0.001km describe the same distance. Try it, then change the right operand to 0.002km. Comparison uses exact compatible dimensions rather than rounded display values.

plots.name: temperature-change-demo
plots.title: Units: a temperature change
plots.lesson: Predict a change of 9 degrees Fahrenheit in kelvin. Try it: the change is 5 K, without an absolute-temperature offset. Compare with the units chapter, then change the source to 18°F and predict the new change.

plots.name: inexact-conversion-demo
plots.title: Units: inspect an inexact refusal
plots.lesson: Try converting the absolute temperature 1°F to °C. The exact finite-decimal profile refuses silently rounded coordinates. Change 1°F to 32°F: the result is exactly 0°C, so the refusal check changes. A typed result refusal differs from invalid source syntax.
